derivation:
rw [← IsNilpotent.isUnit_quotient_mk_iff (I := I.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n)))]
· rw [← isUnit_map_iff (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLE (Ideal.pow_le_self hn))]; rfl
· exact ⟨n, by simp [← Ideal.map_pow]⟩
explanation: The ideal I.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n)) is nilpotent when n ≠ 0. Applying the nilpotent-ideal criterion gives the equivalence after quotienting S/I^n by this image; the double-quotient equivalence identifies that quotient with S/I. The theorem’s proof already uses this criterion.
